# Tetromino Game

This project was developed with [Create React App](https://github.com/facebook/create-react-app).

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/thisisrishabh22/Tetromino.git

cd Tetromino
```

## Usage

```bash
yarn install

yarn start
```
